description: Solve a Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA and return a valid token that can be submitted with the target form. Use this whenever an autonomous agent is blocked by Turnstile on a web page. Target success rate: 95%+. Typical latency: 2-3 seconds.

sitekey.description: The Turnstile sitekey — found in the widget HTML as the `data-sitekey` attribute of the `cf-turnstile` element, or in the URL parameter for the widget iframe.

url.description: The full URL of the page where the Turnstile widget is embedded (used as the referrer for the solve attempt).

name: solve_turnstile
